rows.en: Ymir: "Oh, Touya."
Touya: "There's something else I'd like to remember... Is that okay?"
Ymir: "Yes, of course. Then..."
Ymir: "...Touya... Please think about what
you would like to remember."
Touya: (...What I want to remember...)
Maybe 'Changes in Causality'?
No, that's not it...
Nothing in particular...
'What Is Agarthia?'
No, that's not it...
The previous topic after all...
'The State of the World'
No, that's not it...
The previous topic after all...
'Terrorists'
No, that's not it...
The previous topic after all...
'Spirit Mechs and Liebhofen'
The previous topic after all...
That's enough.
Ymir: "...ouya... Touya..."
Touya: "...Oh..."
Ymir: "You must be tired."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Thanks."
Ymir: "You're welcome."
Touya: "Was that... me just now...? What the hell is going on...?"
Forzen: "...That person is you in this world.
The you here is considered not to exist."
Touya: "I don't understand what you're saying...
And Koichiro was in his school uniform...
He was wearing casual clothes just a moment ago..."
Forzen: "You disappeared as an unstable existence,
and time in this world regained its order. That's what happened."
Touya: "?"
Forzen: "Let's see...
All sorts of things happen every day in this world
where you live, don't they?
You build the future by making all kinds of choices...
In other words, a world that was uncertain becomes
definite through those choices.
But surely you've wondered at least once,
what if I'd chosen differently back then?"
Touya: "...What are you getting at?"
Forzen: "What I mean is,
the world you lived in was one of those major branches.
That's all.
Choices don't transform the world. The worlds are
always there, unchanged.
Our limited perception simply makes us believe
that there is only one."
Touya: "...There are lots of other worlds...
Is that what you mean?"
Forzen: "Yes. Worlds different from this one,
worlds of 'what might have been.' There are worlds
for every possible situation."
Touya: "But this is..."
Forzen: "Yes. The world you were in.
But when your existence became uncertain,
it became a world of a different possibility.
It changed by branching, rather than transforming.
That's why you, who shouldn't be here,
were nearly erased."
Touya: "But I'm here, existing in this world...
Why?"
Forzen: "It's simple.
You no longer belong to this world."
Touya: "H-Huh?"
Forzen: "More precisely, you severed your ties with this world
and formed ties with a new one.
With Agarthia, the world we live in..."
Touya: "...Agarthia...?
What's that?"
Forzen: "The name of the world where I was born and raised.
A world separate from the one we're in now.
More precisely, another world branching off
from yours. It's said to have been created around 4,000 years ago,
though the details of its creation
are rather vague and uncertain."
Touya: "Created...?"
Forzen: "According to what I was taught, to defeat a mighty demon king,
three giant gods descended. The battle that followed
released an enormous amount of energy, enough
to destroy the world. To prevent that destruction,
a space was created, and that became
its origin, or so the story goes."
Touya: "Why are there people living in a place like that?
Did they evolve at some ridiculous speed?"
Forzen: "No.
We're the same 'humanity' as in this world."
Touya: "Huh?"
Forzen: "In other words, people from this world
were transported along with it when Agarthia was created,
and their descendants flourished there
to the present day."
Touya: "So that's why you called it 'another world'...
But what's someone from that world doing here?"
Forzen: "Oh? Have you forgotten already?
I've come to 'protect' people like you..."
Touya: "That's not what... Hmm?
'People like me'?
There are others?"
Forzen: "Yes. Six at present.
We still don't know what caused you all to become
existences that aren't fixed in this world.
But we believe it's connected to what happened three years ago.
That's our view."
Touya: "What happened three years ago?"
Forzen: "To be precise, it began 109 years ago.
Researchers led by Bafred Debish
caused the mysterious great explosion, the ≪Terror of Ze=Ode≫.
That was the beginning of everything."
Touya: "How does something that long ago connect to this?"
Forzen: "Though the scale was different, the readings then
were extremely similar to those from three years ago."
Touya: "...And?"
Forzen: "What do you mean, 'And'...?"
Touya: "Is that all?"
Forzen: "That's all."
Touya: "An explosion like the one 109 years ago happened three years ago.
That's all it took for your world
to start taking action?"
Forzen: "Well, yes. But only a very small number
have seriously acted. It's a shame, when the return of the ≪Ze=Ode≫
is all but certain."
Touya: "What's your evidence?"
Forzen: "Trade secret."
Touya: "Y-You..."
Forzen: "Oh? You're going to cooperate with us?
Then let's get started... Oh, just a moment.
Um... If you could sign a new contract..."
Touya: "I'm not! Damn it, I can't let my guard down around you."
Forzen: "Well, in any case, we're working day and night against those ≪Ze=Ode≫.
That's what we're doing.
With you, too, if there's an 'effect,'
there must be a 'cause.' Once we know it,
the solution should become clear."
Touya: "That's so vague..."
Forzen: "Most of reality is buried
in vague phenomena."
Touya: "I don't care about your philosophy of life.
What exactly are these ≪Ze=Ode≫, anyway?"
Forzen: "Hmm, shall I explain in detail?
It should only take about five hours."
Touya: "...Keep it short, please."
Forzen: "Really? What a shame.
Well, to put it simply, the ≪Ze=Ode≫
are like demons. That's all."
Touya: "...No, a little more specific, if you can..."
Forzen: "My, you're demanding...
Hmm... Well, there is little data from that time,
so we don't know the details,
but the leading theory is that they're ancient Armored Mechs."
Touya: "'Armored Mechs'?"
Forzen: "Robots. You have anime like that
in your world too, don't you?"
Touya: (That robot from back then?)
Forzen: "Is something wrong?"
Touya: "No...
You sure know a lot, though."
Forzen: "I may not look it, but I'm quite studious.
Anyway, they tried to use the power of those ancient Armored Mechs
to 'purify Agarthian humanity.'
That was the incident 109 years ago."
Touya: "That Debish guy you mentioned?"
Forzen: "Yes. But his collaborators,
Dr. Wenimas and Dr. Lenis, intervened at the activation stage,
and a great explosion occurred.
The damage was certainly immense, but Dr. Debish's
intended goal wasn't achieved, and we were saved.
Yet the ≪Ze=Ode≫ had
vanished without a trace from the site.
With the data lost, that's about
all we know."
Touya: "So, the incident 109 years ago
was something that Debish guy planned,
and the two doctors working with him stopped it.
That caused a huge explosion, and similar
readings were detected three years ago.
Now you're preparing to oppose the ≪Ze=Ode≫,
which may have returned?"
Forzen: "Excellent.
It's a relief you're so quick on the uptake.
...Now, we should be arriving shortly."
Touya: "...So you want me to pilot one of these Spirit Mechs
and help you wage war?"
Ai: "Hey!"
Ymir: "I understand why you might think that.
But please understand this.
Our aim is to protect the world from the ≪Ze=Ode≫.
We didn't build the Spirit Mechs
for war or slaughter."
Touya: "So you're telling me to cooperate?
That's pretty self-serving logic."
Ymir: "That's not what I mean.
If you refuse, we have no intention of forcing you.
Our original purpose is to 'protect' you."
Celica: "I can't believe they'd target this place..."
Touya: "H-Hey! Who the hell are they?!"
Ymir: "Probably the ≪Dawn of an Era≫.
They claim they'll overthrow a corrupt society and establish a new order,
carrying out acts of destruction everywhere.
Rumor has it their leader changed,
and they'd been a little quieter lately..."
Celica: "In plain terms, a terrorist group."
Touya: "!! Terrorists...?"
Celica: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "Every world is the same, huh..."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "...Hey, what exactly is going on?"
Alforina: "Huh? Oh, yes, of course.
Do you already know we're building Spirit Mechs here?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Alforina: "The person who proposed that project was the man you just met...
Crown Prince Lodis of the Kingdom of Agarthia."
Touya: "Then why here,
in York, instead of his own country?"
Alforina: "The Spirit Mech Development Project was nearly approved by the League Assembly
once, but a dispute over who would lead it
caused trouble, and it all came to nothing."
Touya: "So everyone kept each other in check,
and nothing got decided?"
Alforina: "Yes... Sadly, a hundred years seems to have been enough
to make people forget
that horrible incident."
Touya: "You mean that huge explosion Forzen
was talking about?"
Alforina: "Yes. Its scars now exist only in people's memories,
recognized as history.
Yet the images left behind are
truly 'terror.' The shock of the explosion caused
damage across the world. But the true 'terror'
wasn't the blast itself. It was the earthquakes, tsunamis,
and abnormal weather caused by
its dust: the secondary disasters. The dust, in particular,
hid the 'Orb of Light' shining overhead. Agarthia
experienced something no one had ever known since this world was born:
a 'winter.'
It took several years for Agarthia
to see the light again,
and over a decade longer for the environment to recover.
We must never repeat such a tragedy.
The whole world should be working together,
yet people seem ready to repeat the same mistakes.
We couldn't simply stand by and watch.
That's why we offered our cooperation."
Touya: "I don't know how things stand now, but can York
and just a few allies really manage?"
Alforina: "I'd be lying if I said I had no worries.
But unless we start walking, we can't move forward.
Even if it's only a very small step..."
Arthur: "Clovis, Ai and I share that ideal,
and that's why we're helping."
Touya: "I..."
Alforina: "There's no need to rush
your answer. No one willingly wants
to throw themselves into battle."
Ai: "Hey, the castle's been pretty hectic
since yesterday or so. Did something happen?"
Alforina: "There's nothing to worry about.
Everyone's just a little uneasy."
Ai: "Well, of course.
This country's main force is only four Armored Mechs,
and three of them are away."
Arthur: "Come to think of it, Reduce went to Limberg
as a military adviser, didn't he?"
Touya: "But we have Spirit Mechs, right?
Let's see, the ones for the three people here, and..."
Arthur: "Ai's Vishal, Clovis's Baldock,
my Drydes, and Zeifon. Four in all."
Touya: "Right, right."
Alforina: "Spirit Mechs are certainly powerful.
But if we used them as tools of war,
we'd betray the people
who helped us.
Our real enemy is the ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Tyron: "Excuse me!"
Alforina: "Is something wrong?"
Tyron: "We've detected what appear to be Armored Mechs in Glascher Valley,
several readings in all.
It's possible information about Liebhofen
has leaked outside."
Touya: "What's this 'Liebhofen'?"
Alforina: "It's part of the Spirit Mech Development Project,
a mobile fortress we built.
It's already capable of withstanding actual combat,
so it would be disastrous if it were captured."
Ai: "But who could it be?"
Tyron: "Huh? W-Well..."
Alforina: "It might be a Zigrim unit.
We've also heard they're trying to acquire Spirit Mechs to oppose the Kingdom of Agarthia.
That's the information we have."
Touya: "Isn't Zigrim the country
massing troops at the border?"
Ai: "Maybe that border force is a diversion,
and this unit is the real attack."
Tyron: "Y-Yes, I'm sure that's it.
In any case, we need to investigate."
Alforina: "I'm sorry to ask, but would you do that for us?"
Arthur: "I don't mind, but..."
